title: Tesla Cybercab terms reportedly require $299 monthly autonomy subscription
summary: A secondary report says Tesla&\#x27;s Cybercab terms pair a $29,990 vehicle price with a mandatory $299-per-month autonomous-driving subscription that must remain active for the car to operate. The terms reportedly let Tesla change the subscription price with one month&\#x27;s notice and suspend or cancel service for nonpayment or misuse; three accumulated warnings disable autonomous driving for a week. They also restrict the car to designated operating areas and prohibit connecting it to ride-hailing, delivery, or rental platforms without authorization. The report does not include the full agreement or independent verification; Electrek notes that Cybercab and the robotaxi Model Y share AI4 hardware and autonomous software, while consumer FSD still requires human supervision.
